commits.subject: docs(albanese): four surviving copies of the deleted 'carrier is not named' caveat
commits.summary:
**Janitor stale-claim sweep, run 0069 r7.** The bold caveat deleted from `SymPowColimit.lean` §5 survived as a live assertion in four other places. Repaired: `SymPowAffineCarrier.lean` (its scope section still said the composition is "**not** written" — it is `colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed`), `TensorPowerCofan.lean` and `SymPowAffineQuotient.lean` (both cited the caveat in the present tense), and `SymPowColimit.lean` §5s own closing paragraph, which still read "identifying the carrier is unfinished work".

**`SymPowInvariants.lean` was the worst of them, and nothing had flagged it.** Its header, Scope and §4 each asserted the three inputs it left open were "still open" — all three landed (`permMulSemiringAction`, `fixedCoconeUnderIsColimitOp`, `colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed`) — and it carried a measured "no declaration in the tree consumes it yet (grep for `fixedConeIsLimit` outside this file returns nothing)" that is now false at two call sites. §4 also predicted the category bridge would go via `Over.opEquivOpUnder`; it was actually done by rebuilding in `Under k`, so the prediction is noted as not what happened.

**Docstring-only; kernel-verified.** All five modules re-checked on a lock-free scratch olean root, EXIT=0 each, no sorries introduced. `horizon graph sync` refreshed the two hgraph nodes (32dfc9f314a5, 873721ca9dc0) that had frozen copies of the old text.
